:::{#exr-affine-map-practice}
#### Testing whether a rescale-and-shift is an affine map

Rescaling a measurement and then shifting it,
as when converting units with a different zero point,
is the typical [affine map](#def-affine-map).
Let $f: \reals^2 \to \reals^2$ be

$$
f(\vx) = (2 x_1 + 1,\ x_2 - 3).
$$

Is $f$ an [affine map](#def-affine-map)?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Look for a $2 \times 2$ [matrix](#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$ and a vector $\vec{b}$
with $f(\vx) = \matr{A}\vx + \vec{b}$.

:::

:::
